text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos claims a magnificent victory in the 
Shuka Sho. Her family rejoiced with 
immense pride as she fulfilled her 
sister's long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After running through the Tiara route and 
enjoying the party her parents threw for 
her, Vivlos reaffirms her resolve to aim 
for the race in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos and her Trainer set the Nakayama 
Kinen as their next target, viewing it as 
a stepping stone to making her dream come 
true.
